title: Gallaudet visits Skinwalker Ranch with Brandon Fugal

tellings.quote: So we went out and we had this great day together.

plain: A retired Navy admiral named Tim Gallaudet says he once spent a day at Skinwalker Ranch, a property in Utah known for reports of strange happenings, together with a businessman named Brandon Fugal. Gallaudet tells it himself, as someone who was there, and says only that "we had this great day together," without describing anything they saw.
